Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected StoneCraft "RiverEdge" light gray quartz countertops ($3,200/slab, delivery June 8) and EcoTemp Pro thermostat. Appliance allowance: $6,300.
* 🟡 (09:20) Selected "Nimbus" brushed nickel pendants ($89 ea) and 12-bottle island wine cooler. Inspections booked (CityPower May 20, WaterWorks rough-in May 28).

</observations>

</current-task>
